header: Migrating data from self-managed OpenSearch clusters using Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion
content:
OpenSearch Ingestion
You can use an Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with self-managed OpenSearch or
Elasticsearch to migrate data to Amazon OpenSearch Service domains and OpenSearch Serverless
collections. OpenSearch Ingestion supports both public and private network conﬁgurations for the
migration of data from self-managed OpenSearch and Elasticsearch.
